driverLimitations: The reference policy caps braking reserve conservatively. Sport brakes plus sport tyres shorten the physical stopping test but do not improve the U-turn elapsed time over sport tyres alone in this batch. Treat this as a driver-policy limit; these laps are not the ideal performance ceiling of each loadout.
